Third-party notice: SADIE II HRTF data
======================================

vsm.exe embeds head-related impulse responses from the SADIE II Database.

  Subject:  D1 (Neumann KU100 dummy head)
  File:     D1_48K_24bit_256tap_FIR_SOFA.sofa
  SHA-256:  e6c72a84dd947b5ef75438ab96a9c2a32ed10f033472b9c4c11a49aff00a8a31
  Obtained: https://sofacoustics.org/data/database/sadie/D1_48K_24bit_256tap_FIR_SOFA.sofa
  Project:  https://www.york.ac.uk/sadie-project/database.html
            https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12092466

Changes: none to the data. The original SOFA file is stored zlib-compressed
inside vsm.exe and restored byte for byte (verified by the SHA-256 above)
before use.

Reference: C. Armstrong, L. Thresh, D. Murphy and G. Kearney, "A Perceptual
Evaluation of Individual and Non-Individual HRTFs: A Case Study of the SADIE II
Database", Applied Sciences 8(11):2029, 2018. https://doi.org/10.3390/app8112029
